Senior PHP Engineer

Northwind Systems runs the clearing platform that moves parcels between regional depots, and we are looking for a senior PHP engineer to join the team that keeps it honest. You will own the services that reconcile depot scans against the shipping manifests, and you will be the person other teams come to when a reconciliation disagrees with reality.

The platform is a long-lived Laravel application with a queue-heavy design: most of what it does happens out of band, driven by jobs that have to be safe to retry. We care a great deal about idempotency, about observable failure, and about tests that describe behaviour rather than implementation. You would spend your first month pairing on the reconciliation service before taking a slice of it on yourself.

What we are looking for

  • Several years of PHP in production, including work you would still defend today.
  • Comfort with a relational database under load, and with the queries that go wrong there.
  • A habit of leaving a codebase easier to change than you found it.

We work four days in the Leeds office and one wherever suits you. Interviews are a conversation, a pairing session on our own code, and a chat with the depot operations team whose work the platform exists to support.

Northwind Systems is an equal opportunities employer.
